description: Dialog (a core TmModal) for configuring and triggering a Gantt export: format tiles (PDF, PNG, Excel, MS Project XML) as a radio group, the options that apply to the chosen format (paper, orientation, critical path, today line, workload, zoom for PDF/PNG; the columns for Excel) and a live preview area with a built-in miniature of the chosen format and options.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Fires when the dialog should close.

parameters.name: PreviewContent
parameters.description: Content of the preview area. When null (default) the area shows the built-in preview when PreviewTasks are supplied, otherwise the neutral "Preview" placeholder; a host that renders its own preview supplies it here and always wins over the built-in preview.

parameters.name: PreviewTasks
parameters.description: The visible tasks the built-in preview sketches. When null or empty the area keeps the neutral placeholder (the dialog has nothing truthful to draw). The host's own PreviewContent slot always wins over the built-in preview.

parameters.name: PreviewDependencies
parameters.description: Dependencies between the PreviewTasks; drawn as short connectors.

parameters.name: PreviewCriticalPathIds
parameters.description: Ids of the tasks on the critical path, painted when the critical-path option is on.

parameters.name: ShowBuiltInPreview
parameters.description: Whether the built-in preview renders when PreviewTasks are supplied. Default true.

parameters.name: OnExport
parameters.description: Fires when the user confirms export with the chosen options.
